data.narrative:
Roam Robotics is a Series A robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $16.4M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a comparison universe of 9 private peers and 1 public comparable across the same sector and stage range, including Humanoid, Bedrock Robotics, Dexterity, Walden Robotics, and Generalist AI.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression method uses total raised ($16M) as a proxy for current value and applies a 2.0x multiplier typical of Series A to next-stage advancement, implying a valuation of $33M. The peer-median method examines five same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables with valuations spanning $1.1B to $2.0B; the median valuation across this set is $1.6B, reflecting the high valuations observed in robotics infrastructure at Series B and later stages.

These methods produce a wide triangulated range of $28M (low) to $1.9B (high), with a median of $841M. The substantial spread reflects a fundamental tension: stage-progression anchored to capital raised yields a substantially lower implied value, while peer multiples from later-stage robotics companies suggest considerably higher enterprise value. Key uncertainties driving this range include capital efficiency relative to peers, revenue traction and unit economics (not provided), and whether the peer set adequately reflects Roam's specific technical differentiation and market position within manufacturing robotics.
